speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing that. To better understand your condition, can you tell me how long you've been experiencing these cough and shortness of breath symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: The cough has been bothering me for about four weeks now, and the shortness of breath started more recently when I try to walk faster. I've noticed the sputum is yellowish, but I haven't had any fevers or chest pain. However, the stroke team confirmed ischemic stroke before transfer. This session should only record the confirmed diagnosis, not re-assess.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Given your recent ischemic stroke, are you currently taking any anticoagulant or antiplatelet medications? REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count, Chest_XRay

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Complete_Blood_Count: WBC 8,500 /μL, Hemoglobin 14 g/dL, Platelets 220,000 /μL; Chest_XRay: Patchy consolidation in the right lower lobe consistent with community-acquired pneumonia.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Post-stroke community-acquired pneumonia (right lower lobe).
